items.raw_excerpt: Shiroda panchayat in Goa’s Ponda taluka declared TB-free for 3 years, earning a gold award; Borim gets silver as cases decline over the past decade.
items.summary_en: Shiroda village in Goa, India has been declared tuberculosis-free for three consecutive years. The panchayat earned a gold award as TB cases in the area have been declining over the past decade. Nearby Borim also received a silver award for its efforts in reducing TB cases.

items.raw_excerpt: A ranch formerly owned by drug kingpin Edgar Valdez Villarreal — aka “La Barbie” — will be converted into a high school and health complex
items.summary_en: A ranch in central Mexico formerly owned by drug kingpin Edgar Valdez Villarreal, known as La Barbie, will be converted into a high school and health complex. The property, called El Paraíso, is located in Atlacholoaya, about 35 minutes south of Cuernavaca in Morelos state. The site will house a technological agricultural high school, a traditional medicine center, and an office supporting Indigenous and Afro-Mexican communities.
